environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 native function on AWS Lambda. SIGNING_KEY_SOURCE=hsm. Function's execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ProdHSMBoundary) that grants kms:Sign and kms:Verify only via the CloudHSM-backed custom key store (key policy condition: kms:CallerAccount + aws:SourceVpc restricted to the Lambda VPC). The Lambda is VPC-attached with ENI in a private subnet with no internet egress; the only reachable endpoint is the CloudHSM cluster ENI via security group sg-0a8f3c (port 2223 only). API Gateway is REST API type with a request validator that drops any request containing X-Cache-Key header (validator ID: abc123, validateRequestParameters: true, with a Gateway Response override returning 400 for BAD_REQUEST_PARAMETERS). Additionally, the API Gateway resource policy denies requests where the X-Forwarded-Host header value does not match the stage's custom domain (*.prod.example.com) via a StringNotLike condition on context.identity.sourceIp combined with a method.request.header mapping template that overwrites X-Forwarded-Host with the API's own Host before proxying to Lambda.
